headline: Foreign funds poured in as *DIIs sold*
subline: Nifty closed on its high. Autos led and IT lagged.
hero_text: FIIs put Rs 7,411.41 Cr into cash while DIIs sold Rs 1,356.57 Cr. The Nifty finished at its high of 25,514.30.

why.title: Nifty closed on its high
why.desc: The index rose 1.14% and finished at the session peak.

why.title: FIIs added, DIIs trimmed
why.desc: Foreign cash inflow was large while domestic funds were net sellers.

why.title: Autos led the charge
why.desc: Nifty Auto jumped, with Maruti up 7.58% on the day.

why.title: IT slipped against the tape
why.desc: TCS, Tech Mahindra and Infosys each lost over 1.5%.

sector_reasons.Consumer Durables: Rode the consumption bid with autos
sector_reasons.PSU Bank: State lenders joined the bank bid
sector_reasons.IT: TCS, Infosys and Tech M dragged
sector_reasons.Media: Barely moved while the rest ran
sector_reasons.Realty: Small gain, lagged the broad rally

bonus_text: 1,563 stocks advanced and 1,164 declined across NSE. Inside the Nifty 50, 42 rose and only 8 fell.
movers_note_gainers: Maruti led at 7.58%. Eicher, M&M and TMPV followed on the auto bid.
movers_note_losers: Three IT names led the slide at about 1.5% each. HCLTech also fell.
watch_text: Friday opens with the Nifty above its 25,300 max pain. Option OI marks 25,000 and 26,000 as the range.
lessons: The Nifty 50 was near unanimous, the wider market less so. 42 of 50 rose, yet 1,164 NSE stocks fell.
Consumer names carried the rally. Auto, durables and FMCG all beat the Nifty.
Large caps outran small caps. Nifty Next 50 beat Smallcap 100 by about a point.
The index ended at its high of the day. Nothing was given back into the bell.
alert_text: ECB President Lagarde speaks at 17:45 IST on Friday. US consumer sentiment follows at 00:30 IST.
cta_headline: A broad rally. *Save it for Friday's open*.
cta_sub: Flows split, breadth held. Next bell is Friday 20 November.
next_text: Friday 20 November opens from a close of 25,514.30. Nifty expiry follows on Monday 23 November.
caption_a:
FIIs put Rs 7,411.41 Cr into cash while DIIs sold Rs 1,356.57 Cr.
Nifty rose 1.14% to 25,514.30, closing at its high. 42 of 50 stocks gained.
Auto jumped 4.4%. IT slipped 1.1%.
Watch: Lagarde speaks at 17:45 IST on Friday.
